observations: Stack of four black Sony PlayStation 4 Pro consoles.
Two red DualShock 4 controllers in retail packaging.
The consoles are stacked on top of each other.
A watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.
A UK power outlet with two plugs is visible in the background.
The image appears to be a promotional or stock photo rather than a photo of a single unit in a home environment.

claims.evidence: The photo shows four units, but it is impossible to verify if they are UK models or if they are used.
No games are visible in the photo.
Photo 0 shows two controllers in boxes.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The photo shows four units, but the seller claims only one console.
risks.proof: A photo of the single console being sold, not a stack.

risks.risk: The consoles may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the consoles powering on and a game running.

risks.risk: The consoles may be counterfeit or refurbished.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the official serial number sticker on the back of the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the single console being sold, not a stack.
Photo of the official serial number sticker on the back of the console.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Photo of the game discs mentioned in the seller's words.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
